state.interpretation: For each question, return a probability distribution for the child variable under exactly the stated parent assignment. Treat unspecified variables as unknown; do not assume them false.
state.task: Parameterize a small educational Bayesian network about respiratory disease.
state.population: Imagine a randomly selected adult patient in a general clinical population. Use ordinary real-world medical knowledge, not the memorized textbook Asia-network numbers.
